## Teachers and Practice Resources

Several teachers directly influenced this method. I can’t fully endorse any of them because none follows my whole approach or has expressed interest in doing so. Daja works with inner-child pl/ork intuitively, through the divine Nurturer and Protector archetypes. Her work is less neuroscience and CBT and more direct archetypal practice, and the three grown-up jobs draw a lot from it. She has a [book](https://a.co/d/7Sa4kP2) and a [free one-hour YouTube training](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL_kbcFWhZK0wJeFUShGvHFZa1u3x7p8Y-&si=Fr0g76mDh8-WLMjM), and she's on [Instagram](http://instagram.com/ihopeyoufindserenity).

Lisa Romano brings more neuroscience and CBT, and her [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2tbMRZKdHJ4) is a good place to start. She makes the point that remembering the specific details of childhood trauma isn't necessary, because the felt body knows what needs to come up. [Key](https://open.substack.com/users/432335983-key-to-enlightenment?utm_source=mentions) developed the Guide's sense of direction, and the identity and differentiation work from Bowen I mentioned earlier. She led a [guided inner-child meditation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UkVlDixqqA0) in Nairobi in January 2026 for twenty people, and it's up on YouTube.

If you're looking for a therapist, [Open Path Collective](https://openpathcollective.org/pricing-and-eligibility-for-affordable-therapy/) lists thousands of affordable ones. Filter for Internal Family Systems, since IFS-trained therapists often have the most relevant background for inner-child pl/ork. And for bottom-up support, there's my [Somatic Therapies Guide](http://somatic.u-dont-exist.com/).

## Close the Session and Return to Life

That "Present Time" ending is worth stealing for every session, photos or no photos. Otherwise the processing can go on and on, until it's just one more way to avoid living your life. So when you're done, look around and say where you are. Feel your feet on the floor, or the chair under you, and unclench your jaw and hands, since they've probably been at it this whole time.

Then pick the next normal thing you'll do, like making food or going to sleep, and tell your little one, "That's enough for today. We're going back to the life we're building." Yes, yes, it can feel a bit weird saying that to someone who lives inside you. Nothing has to be resolved first, and whatever you're still feeling can come along. Going back to your life is part of the healing, too.
t71g_secjl3:
## Just Like Me

This one works best on a steadier day, when thinking about other people won't pull you out of your own shoes. Name the feeling plainly. Lonely, say. Then think of how many people are feeling that exact thing right now, and wanting it to stop, just like you. Some of them make it worse trying to get away from it. Just like you, sometimes. 😅 Wish all of you, you first, enough support to stay with it, so the pain stops with you.

You don't need any special breathing. And forgiving whoever hurt you, or imagining their childhood? Also not required, and neither is getting in touch with them (if that ever happens, it's its own decision, made on a calmer day than this). Funny how every one of us figures we're the only one who feels this way. The wish just helps you stop treating a feeling this many people have had as proof that you, specifically, are defective.
